Done P2P on Binance? Then you know the routine. Chats, screenshots, and checking every payment by hand.
KoiPay is a P2P processing platform that brings everything you need into one place. Here's the trader dashboard.
Home shows your net balance, your staked deposit, and your earnings. For today, 7 days, 30 days, or any custom period.
Sahil from Bangalore watched this number grow for 5 months. Then he bought his first bike.
Connect several bank accounts, and switch each one on or off in one tap. Set daily and monthly limits, by count and by amount.
Install the SMS Forwarder, and incoming payments are confirmed straight from your bank SMS.
PayIns are sorted into Pending, Review and Success. If a client appeals, the receipt is right there. Confirm or reject in one click.
Payouts work the same way. The most overdue are on top, and you attach proof in seconds.
Settle your balance to crypto or to your bank. You see the rate and the USDT amount before you confirm.
Every operation lands in the report. Opening balance, closing balance, and your earning on it. Filter by UTR, bank or date, and export.
Your trader score tracks payout speed, PayIn speed and conversion, and shows you exactly how to improve.
Running a team? Add employees with their own login. They handle payments, but they can't see your earnings.
